findings.evidence: RED run: `pnpm vitest run packages/npm-client/src/overrides.test.ts` → `Tests 4 failed | 2 passed (6)`; no test matches /\$ref|\$baz/ in packages/npm-client. Mutant plausibility probe: npm 11.17.0, package.json {"devDependencies":{"chalk":"4.1.2"},"overrides":{"supports-color":"chalk"}} + `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` → `npm error notarget No matching version found for supports-color@chalk` — npm classifies a bare non-range value as the key package's spec, so an npa-faithful rifty classifier would parse '$baz' as a same-name range, silently violating the loud 404 posture while passing every committed test.
